issue_context.title: The columns displayed in the query result are inconsistent with those in MySQL when names is gbk
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
set names gbk;
select hex('一a');
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```
mysql> select hex('一a');
+------------+
| hex('�?')   |
+------------+
| E6B6933F   |
+------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
tidb> select hex('一a');
+------------+
| hex('һa')  |
+------------+
| E6B6933F   |
+------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```
| Release Version: v5.4.0-alpha-585-g38355172e
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 38355172ee7235ffda612ddadf99e47d60b3b051
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2021-12-31 08:05:43
```
